# [A] TOOLS MANIFEST (auto-generated from live TOOL_SCHEMAS - do not hand-edit)
# Muc dich: tra loi 'viec X dung tool nao trong [A]' / which [A] tool for task X.
# Moi dong: TOOL <ten> | tier | required fields | mo ta. Schema day du: GET /api/tools/<ten>/schema.

TOOL list_structure | T1 | required: - | Return a project folder tree without reading file contents. Prefer project_path; path remains a legacy alias. R43.1: compact=true (or verbosity='terse') hard-caps depth=2 and summarizes folders with >30 files.

TOOL read_file_range | T1 | required: file_path | Adaptive pure read for a range or structural scope with bounded output and ranked next_ranges.
TOOL read_context_batch | T1 | required: project_path, requests | Read multiple file ranges or structural scopes under one deterministic token budget.
TOOL architecture_context_pack | T1 | required: project_path | Build a graph-first readonly context pack without auto-reindexing.
TOOL search_code | T1 | required: - | Search the codebase with bounded max_results and max_context_lines. Prefer project_path; path remains a legacy alias.
TOOL get_file_symbols | T1 | required: file_path | List all functions, classes, and variables defined in one file.
TOOL write_fix | T2 | required: file_path, start_line, end_line, new_content | Replace a line range in one file, create a .bak backup, and sync the cache after writing.
TOOL write_new_file | T2 | required: path | Create a new file. Supports dry_run preview, base64 UTF-8 strict, diff_preview, and apply_after_dry_run.
TOOL write_draft_patch | T2 | required: draft_id, start_line, end_line, new_content | Fix ONLY a failed line range of a pending write draft (opened automatically when write_fix/write_new_file validation fails). Backend re-audits the whole draft, returns remaining failed_parts, and SHIPS automatically through the normal write pipeline (backup, validation, symbol ch
TOOL write_draft_status | T3 | required: - | Inspect a pending write draft: remaining failed_parts with line-accurate errors and excerpts. Empty draft_id lists all pending drafts.
TOOL write_draft_abort | T3 | required: draft_id | Discard a pending write draft without writing anything to the target file.
TOOL generate_project_map | T2 | required: project_path | Generate the project cache, INDEX.json, and PROJECT_MAP.md while skipping junk, secret, and generated folders.
TOOL refresh_project_map | T2 | required: project_path | Delete the old cache and rescan the project to rebuild INDEX.json. Large repos can take 60-180s+ -- set call timeout >= 300s; the rescan completes server-side even if the client times out.
TOOL cache_status | T1 | required: project_path | Check project cache status and the latest INDEX.json update time.
TOOL delete_file | T2 | required: file_path | Delete one file at the requested path. This is permanent.
TOOL begin_task | T3 | required: session_id, prompt, agent_id | Confirm or renew a server-owned task checkpoint. For two-phase root claim, send the same owner_claim_id and owner_capability returned by bootstrap_session; confirmation commits immutable ownership. Root owners issue named subtasks with delegate_agent_id; workers renew only with d
TOOL owner_heartbeat | T3 | required: session_id, agent_id, owner_capability | Record authenticated liveness for a committed root owner. The server verifies the capability, stores a timestamp, and exposes only safe active/stale diagnostics; it never returns the capability or its hash.
TOOL get_task_checkpoint | T1 | required: session_id | Return the current compact active-task checkpoint for host reinsertion after tool batches or compaction. When include_owner_status=true, add safe diagnostic state for the server-owned owner claim without returning capabilities or hashes.
TOOL get_rule_core_text | T1 | required: - | Return rendered CORE_RULE text + runtime metadata. HTTP bootstrap; pass stable agent_id.

TOOL set_workflow_mode | T2 | required: project_path, mode | Set workflow mode in WORKFLOW_STATE.json.
TOOL workflow_status_registry | T1 | required: project_path | R43.2 C2: T1 registry inspector — cache/drift/mode/backup state from .orchestrator_cache. Renamed to disambiguate from MD workflow runner.

TOOL capability_status | T1 | required: - | Report parser/indexing capabilities and missing optional libraries.
TOOL suggest_missing_capabilities | T1 | required: - | Suggest optional parser libraries without installing them.
TOOL backup_status | T2 | required: project_path | Read Orchestrator backup manifest status.

TOOL path_quote_helper | T1 | required: command | Generate a Windows-safe run_project_command wrapper for subfolders or paths with spaces. Does not execute.

TOOL backup_project | T2 | required: project_path | Create a timestamped zip backup and backup manifest.
TOOL cache_delta | T2 | required: project_path | Compare the filesystem against INDEX for added, modified, and deleted files.

TOOL get_project_summary | T1 | required: project_path | Return a quick INDEX overview: groups, hotspots, and entry points.

TOOL validate_symbols | T2 | required: file_path | Post-write integration check: syntax plus function/class drift against INDEX.
TOOL validate_encoding | T2 | required: file_path | Validate UTF-8, BOM, mojibake risk, and Vietnamese diacritic integrity after writes.

TOOL list_sessions | T1 | required: project_path | List recent sessions for a project without events.
